Class PlayersAPI

java.lang.Object
PlayersAPI
public class PlayersAPI extends Object
A collection of queries and updates against the Player table in players.db. Each method opens its own connection, runs one SQL statement, and prints the results to standard output. Any SQL errors are printed instead of thrown.

Run CreateDB first to create and populate the database.

  • Method Details

    • printAllPlayers

      public static void printAllPlayers()
      Prints every player's id, name, team, and position, ordered by id. Returns nothing; results are printed to standard output.

    • printPlayerById

      public static void printPlayerById(int id)
      Prints all details for the player with the given id, or "No player found" if no player has that id. Returns nothing; results are printed to standard output.
      Parameters:
      id - the player's id

    • printColumnByTeam

      public static void printColumnByTeam(String column, String team)
      Prints one column's value for every player on the given team. Only the Name, Position, College, and Birthday columns are allowed; any other column prints "Invalid column" and nothing is queried. Returns nothing; results are printed to standard output.
      Parameters:
      column - the column to print: Name, Position, College, or Birthday (case-insensitive)
      team - the team nickname to filter by, e.g. "Chiefs"

    • printNamesByProBowl

      public static void printNamesByProBowl(String position, boolean proBowl)
      Prints the names of all players at a position, filtered by Pro Bowl status. Returns nothing; results are printed to standard output.
      Parameters:
      position - the position abbreviation, e.g. "QB"
      proBowl - true for players who have made a Pro Bowl, false for players who have not
